name: Sutekh
abilities: Red Land's Wrath — sand vortex pulls enemies to center, damage over time
passives: Solar Edict: Sutekh gains Solar Charge — Build by landing abilities — every ability hit on an enemy generates 1 stack. At 3 stacks: Next ability deals +50% damage. At 5 stacks: Ultimate cooldown reduced 30%. Max 5 stacks. Damage escalation — the more you fight, the stronger your strikes.
lore: Sutekh, Red Land Storm God, is now canonized as one of the four playable deities of Aten Ra. The deity is the source-realm divinity behind the mythology rather than a generic champion: desert storm god, chaos-breaker who defends the sun barque against worse chaos. All prior faction, realm, civilization, campaign, and Lore Codex canon remains intact; only the playable roster scale and divine identity layer changed.
personality: A playable mythology deity whose behavior expresses desert storm god, chaos-breaker who defends the sun barque against worse chaos; confident, sovereign, readable in combat, loyal to the unchanged Aten Ra canon.
visualDescription: Sutekh manifests as desert storm god, chaos-breaker who defends the sun barque against worse chaos from Aten Ra: long sharp desert-noble masculine face, angular jaw, ember eyes, severe hooked nose; lean powerful masculine storm-runner build, wiry shoulders, long arms, sand-scarred muscles; signature silhouette: forked crown ears, wind-torn mantle, spear diagonal, jackal-storm outline. Weapon: forked storm-scepter and lightning-wand blade. Maintain the approved Mythos Gates premium stylized tactical RPG aesthetic.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, source-culture weapons, gear, abilities, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Sutekh — Ma’at-Weighted Strike Sever
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Aten Ra source-culture damage at range 3; generate Momentum and a small Solar Charge gain when used from Aten-lit judgment ground or against the marked target. The hit reads visually as Aten hand-rays, Ma’at scale seams, electrum collars, faience/lapis inlay, scarab cores, pylon shields, Nile-black and desert-red balance.
abilityDetails.scaling: 100% attack; +15% when the target is vulnerable or standing in faction-favored terrain
abilityDetails.counterplay: Break line of sight, deny favored terrain, bait the mark, or force the Deity into low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Pylon Edict Technique — Interdiction
abilityDetails.effect: Spend Momentum to cuts enemy resources, scrambles intent, and creates a counter-window instead of raw lockout. Builds Solar Charge only when the Avatar uses Aten-lit judgment ground intelligently; never a generic buff button.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy and mastery tier
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread enemy ranks, deny the setup terrain, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Sutekh: Sun-Scale Decree Null Mandate
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Solar Charge to impose a two-round rule from Solar Dominion of Khepra: cuts enemy resources, scrambles intent, and creates a counter-window instead of raw lockout. Enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack where damage applies; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum/Divinity, stagger the Deity, or exploit the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Aten-Ra Source Radiance
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: amplify Solar Charge, transform nearby terrain into Aten-lit judgment ground, empower one Signature, and reveal the Realm as the original source behind human myth. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, disengage from transformed terrain, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Sutekh Interdictor Ma’at Was-Sceptre Blade
equipmentDetails.effect: +3 attack. Basic attacks gain +4 Momentum once per round when they express source-culture canon through Aten-lit judgment ground. Visual: Aten hand-rays, Ma’at scale seams, electrum collars, faience/lapis inlay, scarab cores, pylon shields, Nile-black and desert-red balance.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action loops; empowered basics are once per round.

equipmentDetails.name: Sutekh Electrum Wesekh Source-Plate
equipmentDetails.effect: Improves survivability and makes the Deity read as Solar Dominion of Khepra source-culture gear, not costume armor. Reduces first terrain/hazard punishment each encounter if the Avatar followed the faction mechanic.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Mitigation cannot stack past role caps; does not erase telegraphed boss danger.

equipmentDetails.name: Sutekh Khepri Solar Scarab Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Stores Solar Charge and unlocks a mastery branch for Aten Hand-Ray Gate Step, Uraeus Counter-Edict, and Weigh the Name. Rewards correct terrain and reaction play rather than passive stat gain.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Resource refund has a per-round cap and cannot chain Ascension windows.

leveling.powerFormula: hp + attack*6 + range*5 + energy*7 + speed*6 + armor*2 + resistance*2 + critChance

balanceNotes.intendedDifficulty: Tuned for harder solo encounters: every deity can win alone, but mistakes against counters starve Momentum/Divinity.
balanceNotes.primaryRole: interrupt resources, casts, reactions, and elite mechanics
balanceNotes.uniqueMechanic: Sutekh's Solar Edict: a solo mechanic where Solar Charge grows through Aten-lit judgment ground, reaction-window mastery, and disruptor decisions that place a false timing window that punishes enemy overcommitment. Payoff: break enemy cadence and steal tempo during reaction prompts. Counterplay: patient enemies, cleanses, and baited reactions waste the setup; enemies can also drain Momentum/Divinity before the upgraded Signature resolves.
balanceNotes.counterplayRule: patient enemies, cleanses, and baited reactions waste the setup
